name: container
description: A centred, max-width content column with token-bound inline gutters. `size` caps the width against the breakpoint scale (RFC 0025) and `gutter` sets the inline padding — `responsive` (the default) escalates it at the md and lg breakpoints, the fixed steps pin one value at every width. No inline styles: both props are curated presets (RFC 0022 §8).

modifiers.name: size
modifiers.description: The width the content column stops growing at, resolved against the breakpoint scale so `size="lg"` caps exactly where the `lg` breakpoint begins.

options.name: lg
options.description: Caps at the lg breakpoint (64rem) — the default.

options.name: full
options.description: No cap — fills its parent. Gutters still apply; pair with `gutter="none"` for true edge-to-edge.

modifiers.name: gutter
modifiers.description: Inline padding between the content column and its edges. Each step is a density-scaled Context token.

options.name: responsive
options.description: Escalates sm → md → lg at the md and lg breakpoints (the default).

options.name: none
options.description: No inline padding — content runs to the column's edges.

options.name: sm
options.description: The small gutter, pinned at every width.

options.name: md
options.description: The medium gutter, pinned at every width.

options.name: lg
options.description: The large gutter, pinned at every width.
